name: nusantara-chess
description: NusantaraChess - frontend React/TSX + skrip fitur (dibangun ke dist/) dan fungsi SSR Vercel (api/ssr). Backend Express ada di server/.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:ssr && npm run build:node && npm run build:key-generator
scripts.build:web: node tools/prepare-dist.mjs && node tools/build-ts.mjs web && node tools/build-app.mjs && node tools/verify-dist.mjs
scripts.build:vercel: node tools/prepare-dist.mjs && node tools/build-ts.mjs web && node tools/build-app.mjs --production && node tools/build-ssr.mjs --vercel && node tools/minify-dist.mjs && node tools/verify-dist.mjs --vercel
scripts.test:unit: node tests/unit/gamereview-engine.mjs && node tests/unit/gamereview-fallback.mjs && node tests/unit/gamereview-i18n.mjs && node tests/unit/review-scoring.mjs
